def feature_mean(config,selected_subgroups=None):
    if selected_subgroups is None:
        final_df = {}
        for file in config["project_files"]:
            df = pd.read_csv(config["data_directory"]+"/"+file,header=0,index_col="frame")
            final_df[file]=df.mean(axis=0)
        final_df=pd.DataFrame(final_df)
    else:
        if selected_subgroups=="all":
            selected_subgroups=list(config["subgroups"].keys())
        final_df=[]
        for subgroup in selected_subgroups:
            group_df = {}
            for file in list(config["subgroups"][subgroup]):
                df = pd.read_csv(config["data_directory"]+"/"+file,header=0,index_col="frame")
                group_df[file]=df.mean(axis=0)
            group_df=pd.DataFrame(group_df)
            group_df.columns = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples([(subgroup, col) for col in group_df.columns])
            final_df.append(group_df)
        final_df=pd.concat(final_df,axis=1)
    return final_df
        
df = feature_mean(config,selected_subgroups="all")

au_list = list(df.index)
sig_au=[]
for au in au_list:
    com = df["comedic"].loc[au].to_numpy()
    dram = df["dramatic"].loc[au].to_numpy()
    res=ttest_ind(com,dram)
    if ((res.pvalue<0.1) and ("AU" in au)):
        print(au)
        print(res)
        sig_au.append(au)
        plt.figure(figsize=(3,3))
        plt.boxplot([com,dram],positions=[1,2],labels=["Comedy","Drama"])
        plt.title(au)
